name: Podman outside of Podman
description: Gives the dev container a client for the Podman engine of the host, through the bind-mounted directory of the host's Podman API socket. No engine runs in the container.

compose.description: Compose tool. podman-compose runs the podman command, which uses the host engine. It is the compose provider of 'podman compose' and, with dockerCompat, of 'docker compose'.

dockerCompat.description: Install podman-docker (a docker command that runs podman, here as a client of the host engine) and link /var/run/docker.sock to the client socket /run/podman/podman.sock. No Docker CLI is installed. When docker-in-docker, docker-outside-of-docker or a different docker command is present, the install skips this option.
